claims.summary: For a binary quadratic input tuple F on v variables and any supplied Hilbert-like refutation C, every injective binary affine embedding psi(t)=Ut+c with k parameters has a fixed circuit A independent of C such that M=1+A(x,F,b) vanishes on the slice and C'=A+MC is a Hilbert-like refutation with C'(psi(t),Y,Z)=A(psi(t),Y,Z). Explicit parameter-cube selectors and quadratic monomial telescoping construct Boolean corrections; a left inverse V transports parameter Boolean placeholders to VZ using b(psi(t))=U b(t). From input size u/depth Delta and certificate size S/depth d, size is O(S+u+a+v(k+1)+2^k(k+1)^3), depth at most max(d,Delta+8)+2. Coefficient degree L increases to at most L+k+2. Rank-family fixed slices with k=O(log N) consequently have cheap full-certificate data after a polynomial-overhead patch. No simultaneous-all-slice, adaptive-slice, exact simulation-image or unconditional small-refutation assertion.
claims.assessment: Working exact selector, affine-left-inverse and residual-patch proof with explicit Boolean placeholders and circuit cost, passed by the sole medium reviewer. Fixed-slice and supplied-certificate scope retained.
claims.rationale: Calibrates the correlated-slice route at the goal's polynomial-size bounded-depth parameters, beyond survival of the earlier coordinate support mask.
claims.next_action: Seek a hard full-certificate property beyond fixed logarithmic-parameter affine slices, without assuming the remaining exponential selector cost is a lower bound.
